sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Power of Persuasion is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: ""Greetings, soldier! Got a rather specific job for you. I need a close-quarters weapon put through a proper field test. True combat conditions only. I reckon you know exactly where to find those, eh?Some of my customers aren't convinced this little beauty can get the job done... Think you can persuade them?Oh, one more thing: if you lose the gun, you can get a new one from Mechanic."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with an MP5SD on Woods, Ground Zero, Interchange or Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Electric motor
- Unlocks Duck Hideout shooting range target style
"Well done, mission accomplished. Looks like every last customer has been persuaded."

sections.heading: Initial equipment
sections.text:
| Icon | Item name | Amount |
| MP5 | HK MP5 9x19 submachine gun (Navy 3 Round Burst) | 1 |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
The following parts are required to be on an MP5 for it to qualify for this quest:
- HK MP5SD 9x19 upper receiver
- HK MP5SD 9x19 sound suppressor
- HK MP5SD polymer handguard
